justification: In core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/demo/MakeHotSpotLog.java the class is ~550 lines and contains nearly 40 callable members; the constructor at lines 33-56 orchestrates many unrelated demo routines in sequence. The file mixes distinct responsibilities in one class: arithmetic helpers (add/sub), branch tests, intrinsic tests, big-method/inlining stress, sorting, call-chain/inlining tests, virtual dispatch, string uppercasing, loop unrolling, a padding/sleep method, and CLI parsing/main. That breadth and low cohesion indicate insufficient modularization.
